questions.stem: A 28-year-old girl realized that she felt very exhausted and tired after a short walk. She also experienced leg cramps and shortness of breath. On examination, radiofemoral delay was noted and BP in the upper limb was 110/80 mmHg and in the lower limb was 90/60 mmHg. Chest x-ray showed notching of ribs. Echocardiography showed narrowing of the archof the aorta beyond attachment of ligamentum arteriosum. All the statements pertaining to the above condition are correct except?
questions.stemHtml: A 28-year-old girl realized that she felt very exhausted and tired after a short walk. She also experienced leg cramps and shortness of breath. On examination, radiofemoral delay was noted and BP in the upper limb was 110/80 mmHg and in the lower limb was 90/60 mmHg. Chest x-ray showed notching of ribs. Echocardiography showed narrowing of the archof the aorta beyond attachment of ligamentum arteriosum. All the statements pertaining to the above condition are correct except?

options.label: A
options.text: The girl was diagnosed to have coarctation of aorta

options.label: B
options.text: Notching of ribs is due to dilatation and tortuosity of posterior intercostal arteries

options.label: C
options.text: The ligamentum arteriosum extends from pulmonary trunk to the descending aorta distal to the origin of left subclavian artery

options.label: D
options.text: There is reversal of blood flow in posterior intercostal arteries
